## Included data and provider access

All twelve project baselines have their teaching inputs and worked reports
in the two ZIP volumes. The package preserves source attribution, software
notices and the documented provider conditions.

Selected WDI and Penn World Table fields and the attributed retail teaching
extract are included. The historical Bank of Ghana input has an official
reconstruction route. FAOSTAT contextual holdings and controlled Ghanaian
survey or programme microdata use the documented provider or custodian
route. Use the included synthetic teaching fixtures for the baseline labs.

[Read the complete access guide](reader_access.md) and [reader use terms](READER_USE.md).

## Find and run code

After extracting both volumes, open `projects/results/portfolio/P01` through
`P12`. Each project's `engine_routes.csv` gives the actual paths for Python,
R, SQL and the local Stata do-file. The chapter listing index explains
which printed code is a contextual excerpt and where its executable
context lives. Keep the source, sample, model and inference keys together.

Python and R model-fitting routes and supported DuckDB preparation and
likelihood checks are documented by chapter. The SQL role varies with the
statistical problem. The retained licensed Stata outputs and their logs
can be read without installing Stata.
